summary.text: Sara McGee is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 132 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Mike Schofield.
She is a healthcare administrator from the Katy area.

paragraphs.text: Sara McGee earned a high school diploma from Katy High School and a bachelor's degree from Midwestern State University in 2020.
Her career experience includes working as a healthcare administrator.
She won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for District 132 with no opposition.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a longtime Katy-area resident, healthcare leader and mother who worked her way through school as a single mother.

She listed strengthening public education, making Texas more affordable and expanding access to healthcare as her key campaign messages, and said she opposes using public dollars for private school voucher programs.
